programs.title: Cheese Slices
programs.desc: Until recently many of the traditional cheeses made in Spain were unknown outside the country. Will travels to the land of Don Quixote to look at Manchego before visiting a cheese fair in the medieval city of Trujillo to savour Queso de la Serena. Finally he drives to the magnificent Picos Europa to discover a blue cheese matured in limestone caves and another wrapped in leaves.
